d:
Eryndor invites all non-summoned enemies to play his game. Each enemy independently rolls a die to determine their outcome.
Whenever a different ally inflicts a stat reduction effect on an enemy, that enemy permanently gains 1 stack of Woe, stacking up to [[3]] times. Each stack of Woe reduces the enemy's roll by [[1]].
If the final roll is [[3]] or lower, the enemy loses the game, surrendering [[20%]] of their ATK and [[15%]] of their max HP to Eryndor and taking [[160%]]<ATK> damage [[3]] times.
Eryndor can claim stats from each enemy up to [[3]] times. The total ATK and max HP Eryndor gains this way cannot exceed [[100%]] of his corresponding stats.
Increases the damage dealt to an enemy who loses Eryndor's game to [[170%]]<ATK>.
Increases the damage dealt to an enemy who loses Eryndor's game to [[180%]]<ATK>.
Increases the damage dealt to an enemy who loses Eryndor's game to [[190%]]<ATK>.
Increases the damage dealt to an enemy who loses Eryndor's game to [[200%]]<ATK>.

Eryndor unleashes [[9]] fan blades to strike non-summoned enemies in order from lowest to highest HP percentage, dealing [[70%]]<ATK> damage per blade. Each stack of Woe on a target further increases the damage they take from this skill by [[10%]].
Increases the damage of each hit to [[75%]]<ATK>.
Increases the damage of each hit to [[80%]]<ATK>.
Increases the damage of each hit to [[85%]]<ATK>.

Eryndor throws a spinning fan into the area with the most enemies and gains a shield that absorbs [[300%]]<ATK> damage. The fan remains in that area for [[1.5]]s, dealing [[170%]]<ATK> damage [[4]] times to enemies within 1 tile. Upon the fan's return, Eryndor gains an extra shield equal to [[20%]] of the actual damage dealt by this skill. Shields granted by this skill last for [[8]]s.
Increases damage to [[180%]]<ATK>.
Increases damage to [[190%]]<ATK>.
Increases damage to [[200%]]<ATK>.
Eryndor gains [[10]] Haste during battle. When an enemy loses his game, he gains an extra [[6]] Haste.
Eryndor gains [[14]] Haste during battle. When an enemy loses his game, he gains an extra [[7]] Haste.
Eryndor gains [[18]] Haste during battle. When an enemy loses his game, he gains an extra [[8]] Haste.

When Eryndor uses his Ultimate, if an enemy loses his game, his Ultimate lands 1 extra hit that deals [[200%]]<ATK> damage to that enemy. Each subsequent loss by that enemy increases the number of extra hits they take by 1, up to [[3]] hits.
Increases the damage dealt by extra hits to [[225%]]<ATK>.

Once a non-boss enemy has lost Eryndor's game [[2]] times, they are permanently stripped of all stat buffs for the rest of the battle, and their ATK is further reduced by [[15%]] of Eryndor's ATK, down to a minimum of [[20%]] of the target's initial ATK.
Increases the damage dealt by extra hits to [[250%]]<ATK>.

r.d: In Rivalry Mode, casting an Ultimate increases damage dealt by [[8%]] for the next [[8]]s. Unstackable. The first Ultimate cast also permanently increases Energy recovery from attacking by [[8%]].
Refine 4: In Rivalry Mode, increases 15 Haste, 15 Execution.

d: When a battle starts, Eryndor collects [[7%]] of every non-summoned enemy's [[basic stats|basicattr]] as an entry fee. The total amount collected for each stat cannot exceed [[35%]] of Eryndor's corresponding stat.
